description: The Claude Code adapter's binding of capability classes to harness tier aliases. The Agent tool's `model` field accepts ONLY the tier aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) — never a full model id, verified live 2026-09-13 — so every class rides an alias, and the broker launcher exports each under its ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variable: one alias carries one model per launch. The review class rides `fable`, the one alias no coding class uses, so that on the broker path it never shares code-high's export (both on `opus`, the reviewer would have followed code-high onto the cheap tier — which is exactly what happened before this binding). Harness-specific by nature; nothing outside runtime/ reads this file.
